name: Nebius Group
day_summary: Nebius is having a rough session — $259.66, down 5.66% (-$15.59) from a $275.25 prior close, trading in a wide $249.21–$276.15 band on 14.7M shares. There was no company-specific bad-news headline; the move is risk-off rotation out of the most expensive, highest-beta AI-infrastructure names, compounded by Micron's blowout pulling capital toward 'cheaper' AI-memory expressions. NBIS remains a hyper-growth story — Q1 FY26 revenue was $399M (+684% YoY), FY26 guidance is $3.0–3.4B revenue at ~40% adj. EBITDA margin, the contracted backlog is ~$47B, and contracted power exceeds 3.5GW — but at a $65.9B market cap the stock trades on backlog and faith, so on a risk-off day it gives back the most. Bears won the tape today.
long_pnl: Longs are still up enormously over 12 months (NBIS ranged from a $43.89 low to a $299.86 high) but gave back ~5.7% today; anyone who chased the $276 area this week is underwater on the week as the name digests its run.
short_pnl: Shorts and tactical faders had a clean green day — the rejection from $276 and slide to $249 rewarded fading strength in the most stretched AI-cloud name, though the structural short remains dangerous against a $47B backlog and a $2B Nvidia strategic investment.

decision.horizon: 1–2 quarters · into the Q2 FY26 print (~Aug 2026) and proof of capex-to-revenue conversion
decision.rationale: HOLD at medium conviction — high-variance. Nebius is arguably the purest public proxy for the 'AI buildout is bottlenecked on compute and power' thesis: an AI-native neocloud growing revenue ~7x YoY, with a ~$47B backlog anchored by Microsoft and Meta, a $27B Meta agreement, a $2B Nvidia strategic investment, and >3.5GW of contracted power. That is exactly the bottleneck Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness fund is long elsewhere — yet notably NBIS did NOT appear in his Q1 2026 13F, a gap worth watching. The catch is the price: a $65.9B cap on ~$3B of FY26 revenue, funded by an enormous $20–25B FY26 capex plan that implies heavy financing and dilution risk. This is a position to own small and add on washouts, not to chase. Today's -5.7% is sentiment, not a thesis break; sizing discipline matters more here than entry timing.

positioning.iv_note: Implied vol is high (~80%) and justified — NBIS is a young, momentum-driven name with wide daily ranges. Options are expensive; defined-risk structures are preferable to naked premium on either side.
positioning.short_interest: Elevated short interest typical of a richly-valued, fast-moving AI name; squeeze risk on any major contract headline.
positioning.notable_flow: Put demand picked up as the stock lost $270 then $260; protective and directional puts dominated the tape on the -5.7% slide. Watch the $250 strike — it aligns with both max pain and today's low.

what_traders_are_doing: Treating NBIS as a high-beta sentiment proxy for the AI-infrastructure trade. Playbook: (1) respect the volatility — size positions for an 80% IV name that can move ±6% with no news, as it did today; (2) buy washouts, don't chase rips — the $249 area (today's low, near max pain) is the first place to look for support; (3) watch the capex-funding cadence — a $20–25B build on ~$3B of revenue means equity/debt raises are the key risk, and any dilution headline is a near-term overhang; (4) track the Situational Awareness angle — if Aschenbrenner's next 13F shows a NBIS position initiated, that is a sentiment tailwind for the copy-trade thesis; (5) levels: hold $249 and the uptrend is intact, lose it and $230 then the $200 round number come into play.

outlook.short_term: Volatile and sentiment-driven. With no fresh catalyst until the Q2 print, NBIS will trade as a high-beta read on AI-infrastructure risk appetite. Expect wide swings; $249 is the line that separates 'healthy pullback' from 'trend damage,' and reclaiming $276 would signal the dip is bought.
outlook.long_term: If Nebius converts its ~$47B backlog and 3.5GW of power into the guided revenue ramp without crippling dilution, it is one of the best-positioned pure-play AI neoclouds — the literal compute-and-power bottleneck the AI buildout depends on. The bet hinges on execution and financing: the $20–25B capex plan is both the bull case (scale) and the bear case (cash burn). High reward, high risk — a deliberately small, conviction sleeve.

bull_case: Revenue compounding ~7x YoY ($399M in Q1 FY26) — among the fastest growth in public tech.
~$47B contracted backlog anchored by Microsoft and Meta gives rare demand visibility for a young company.
>3.5GW of contracted power — Nebius owns the exact bottleneck (power + compute) the AI buildout is short of.
Validation from a $27B Meta agreement and a $2B Nvidia strategic investment.
A pure, liquid public proxy for the Situational Awareness 'pick-and-shovels' AI-infrastructure thesis.
bear_case: Extreme valuation: ~$65.9B cap on ~$3B FY26 revenue leaves no margin for error.
$20–25B FY26 capex implies large debt/equity raises — dilution and financing risk are the core overhang.
High beta and ~80% IV — the stock can fall 6%+ on sentiment alone, as it did today.
Customer concentration in a handful of hyperscalers; any AI-capex digestion hits neoclouds early.
Notably absent from Aschenbrenner's Q1 2026 13F despite fitting his thesis — smart money may see the price as the problem.

analysis: Nebius is the cleanest public expression of the thesis our Situational Awareness desk lays out: the scarce inputs in the AI era are compute and power, and Nebius has locked up both — >3.5GW of contracted power and a ~$47B backlog with the largest hyperscalers. The irony tracked on this desk is that Aschenbrenner, whose fund is long the picks-and-shovels everywhere else, did not show NBIS in his Q1 2026 13F — most likely because the valuation does the bottleneck no favors at ~22x forward revenue. Today's -5.7% is a sentiment flush, not a thesis break, and it came on a day capital rotated toward Micron's 'cheaper' AI-memory beat. The investment question is not whether Nebius is well-positioned — it plainly is — but whether it can fund a $20–25B buildout without diluting holders into the ground. Own it small, add on washouts toward $249 and below, and let execution (not price momentum) drive any add.
